note: Whether each provider would serve an identified crawler, read from its own robots.txt and — only where robots permitted it — one request to its front page. Nothing was crawled. This says who would let us read them, not who should be read: what a provider holds, and whether it names ground finely enough to colour a dot, is a separate question per provider. CAVEAT, FOUND AFTERWARDS: `open` here means the robots.txt permitted us and the FRONT PAGE answered. It does not promise that the search or the API behind it will. Szukaj w Archiwach is listed open and is already in _declined.json — its pages answer while /api returns an Incapsula challenge. So this file narrows the field honestly and does not settle any single source; each one still has to be opened and looked at.
